fga_consultation.use: Advisory input for local staffing decisions.

primary: package lock and generated asset manifest
shared_ownership.rule: Feature authors use isolated worktrees. Primary integrates shared-file edits serially and validates the combined candidate.

execution_rules: Before any story work, verify prerequisite acceptance and move the story into In Progress.
Independent source review, required combined checks, browser verification and primary verification precede RFR.
Use Standard speed, at most 16 direct active subagents and depth one.
Launch ready author packets at turn opening; defer contract-dependent coauthors until their fixture is ready. Launch zero reviewers at turn opening.
Authors submit their packets and exit on completion. Primary assembles a reviewable result from the saved worktrees.
Start the named fresh technical reviewer only when the story authors have exited and the result is ready.
Start the named Terra visual reviewer when a rendered turn candidate is ready. Keep all nine planned Terra passes because all current leads are Sol.
Primary runs prescribed checks by default and can dispatch a Luna worker only to a ready packet that enables useful parallel work.
One Go build/vet/test lease and one browser operator remain in force; at most two independent Node/TypeScript checks run concurrently.
Completed technical work reaches RFR after required verification. Owner demos run at turn end; Terry controls Completed.
Reviewers with findings exit; correction authors and re-reviewers start when actual work is ready.
Refresh remaining first-three-turn staffing and readiness at each handoff.

independent_review.scope: On-demand dispatch, sub-turn lifespan, preserved verification gates, Terra coverage and capacity math.

objective: Reduce cumulative T1-T9 elapsed time through substantive parallel authoring with explicit net coordination costs.

assumptions: Savings include estimated extra interface agreement, integration and review coordination; unchanged baseline checks, review and owner waiting are outside the original author-only baseline.
T2 saving is counted once using max(549,550), not the sum of both branch gains.
With 15 minutes of joint T2 overhead, the slower completed T2 story must finish in 85-100 minutes to reach the 20-35-minute turn saving.
These are provisional sizing scenarios, not measured agent runtimes. Additional coupling or review cycles can erase the gain.
Keep a zero-saving sensitivity case and record actual contract, author, merge, review and resource-wait time before expanding splits.
not_split: T3 has three tied maxima; accelerating one leaves the turn unchanged.
T5 and T6 single-story splits are capped at 15 minutes by the next-longest job and add coupling or slot pressure.
T7 has tied recovery jobs; T8 has one coupled lane-settings authority and only a limited off-critical-path opportunity.
T9 already has Terra visual review, primary-owned prescribed checks and primary integration. No new savings are assigned to relabeling those existing duties.
parallel_authoring.runtime_policy: The primary can assign additional useful author packets within the approved scope and current cap when a concrete independent product materially shortens remaining elapsed time. Otherwise keep one accountable author.

subagent_lifecycle.lifetime: One ready bounded packet, normally shorter than the turn.
subagent_lifecycle.author_start: Dispatch only when story prerequisites and the packet interface/fixture are ready.
subagent_lifecycle.finish: Save the result and exit promptly after the assigned packet finishes.
subagent_lifecycle.followup: Start or resume a worker for a concrete join, correction, verification or review packet when it becomes ready.
subagent_lifecycle.join: Primary joins completed author packets; it may resume the designated lead for a bounded integration task.
subagent_lifecycle.visual: Terra performs a ready bounded visual pass and exits; dispatch another pass when later rendered work is ready.

review_dispatch.technical_review_start: By default, all assigned story authors have finished and exited and the primary has assembled a reviewable result.
review_dispatch.early_review_exception: Launch early only for a completed stable packet whose bounded review unblocks current work. Retire the reviewer when that ready task finishes; reserve no slot in advance.
review_dispatch.visual_review_start: A rendered candidate covering the turn is ready for a bounded inspection.
review_dispatch.visual_policy: Keep a Terra visual pass every turn. A Terra-led visual task can absorb routine visual inspection; independent non-author logic review still applies.
review_dispatch.corrections: Reviewers report findings and exit. Start or resume authors when a concrete correction is ready; obtain a fresh re-review after material changes.
review_dispatch.idle_policy: No worker starts just to wait for authors, a build, browser control or a future review packet.

check_dispatch.optional_condition: A ready, prescribed verification packet can run while the primary performs other useful work.
check_dispatch.compiler_lease: Primary retains the one-at-a-time Go build/vet/test lease.
